continuity_scope: Zero-character evidence audit bound to Lee Yeongdo (이영도)'s Korean novel 눈물을 마시는 새, publisher 황금가지 (Hwanggeum Gaji) serialized/published listing on Naver Series, product 8670449. Excludes game and screen adaptations, sequel material, unofficial translations, and claims about Korean tradition as story canon.

work_or_witnesses.edition: 황금가지 publisher listing / Naver Series product 8670449

coverage_rule: No characters or relationships are asserted. One bibliographic evidence-boundary term records the Korean work-title witness only; no internal terminology is inferred. A character-level pass requires accessible Korean primary text or an authoritative, complete published translation with locators.
omissions: All characters, relationships, internal terms, species, institutions, magic, artifacts, places, religions, and plot claims.
Game/screen adaptations, sequel The Bird That Drinks Blood, uncertain translations, and real-world Korean cultural claims.
uncertainties: The official Naver Series page identifies 황금가지 as publisher and the work's Korean title, but the full serialized text was not available for source-grounded extraction in this environment.
LTI Korea supplies bibliographic title/author context, not a substitute for primary-text character evidence.
Hangul names, romanization, translation, and culture-sensitive claims are deliberately deferred rather than guessed.
Potential violence and other content warnings are not asserted without an accessible witness.
evidence_basis: Authoritative publisher and LTI Korea metadata establish work identity only. The sole source term is an explicitly bibliographic title boundary; no primary Korean chapter text or authoritative full translation was accessible for reliable character, relationship, or internal-term claims.

supports: Korean title 눈물을 마시는 새, author 이영도, and 황금가지 publisher listing.
English printed title The Bird That Drinks Tears and Lee Yeongdo bibliographic context.
